key_insight: SevenNet-Polar extends an equivariant GNN to predict Born effective charges alongside energy, forces, and stress with near-DFT accuracy, enabling faster charge-aware simulations under electric fields.
engineering_relevance: This makes high-throughput screening and molecular dynamics for ferroelectrics, oxides, and perovskite solar-cell materials much more practical at scale.
method: Built on the SevenNet equivariant graph neural network framework
Trained multitask models for energy, forces, stress, and Born effective charges
Used FlashTP acceleration to run large-scale simulations on single- and multi-GPU systems
evidence_signal: The abstract reports BEC RMSE as low as 0.0043 e for BEC-only models and 0.0029 e in multitask models, with energy/force/stress errors of 1.0 meV/atom, 12 meV/Å, and 0.05 GPa.
watch_item: BEC scaling is less favorable than energy/force/stress and the model should still be checked carefully on environments far outside the training set.
paper_title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
